photo: A hypothetical indoor lifestyle photo of one adult seated in a cafe, with a clearly visible empty armchair to the right at a similar depth; existing table and furnishings remain unchanged
person: The main seated person on the left, short black bob, pale-blue striped shirt, light shorts, white socks and shoes, holding a tablet while making a V sign with a pen
hair: Short black bob with a small fringe; retain rounded outer silhouette and a few fringe strokes. No headwear or eyewear is visible
outfit: Pale-blue loose striped shirt with rolled cuffs and only a few dark vertical stripes, light cream shorts as a simple block, white socks and white low shoes. Omit fabric grain and tiny folds
accessories: A dark teal tablet in one hand; the other hand holds a simple white pen while giving the V sign. Use the original hand assignment. No bag is visible; do not invent one
level1: tablet and pen with V sign
unknowns: tablet branding and any hidden jewelry
pose: Sit in the existing empty chair on the right. Echo the real person's V sign and tablet-holding action, while simplifying joint angles and leg placement. Keep both props clearly held, not floating. Do not move the real person
expression: A mild closed-mouth smile and a slight head tilt corresponding to the relaxed real expression
proportion: Design the body from an approximately 3.5-head standing construction, then bend it naturally into a seated posture; do not derive head-body proportion from the compressed seated bounding box
face: Simple oval head, small eyes with minimal white, tiny nose curve and short smile, optional tiny low-contrast cheeks; skin color based on the original person
line_art: Loose Pen: dark-brown slightly variable thin outlines, a few short fringe and cuff marks, clean enough to read without mechanically uniform vector paths
color: Core blocks of black hair, pale-blue shirt, cream shorts, teal tablet and white socks/shoes, plus visible skin and dark line color. Preserve a flat drawing surface under the room's original photographic lighting
placement: Use the existing empty chair to the right; keep the real person, tablet and table readable. Reject the left floor zone because it would obstruct the real shoes

scale.explanation: Size according to the visible existing seat height and depth; the percentage is a secondary seated bounding-height target, not a standing mini-me ratio

grounding: Place the pelvis on the existing chair cushion. Thighs follow the seat plane. Lower legs may hang slightly; do not lengthen legs solely to force feet onto the floor. Pelvis-seat contact is the primary support
perspective: Match the real chair's seat plane and armrest depth; the character's torso remains a flat three-quarter drawing
occlusion: Existing front armrest is in front of the relevant thigh or sleeve; chair back stays behind the character. Preserve original chair dimensions and never erase the armrest
shadow: No realistic cast shadow; only an extremely faint local seat-contact darkening if needed. Preserve all original room shadows
style_consistency: One Loose Pen character with consistent simple face, thin hand-drawn lines and flat restrained color, distinct from all photographic furniture
constraints: No invented chair, no changed furniture, no duplicated tablet, no photorealistic character, no modified human pose or face
